title: One-Block Section 6 Setup
body_html:
One-Block Section 6 Setup

In the single positive-depth case, let \(r=2s\), choose \(w\) with \(M(w)=\Gamma\), and let \(L'\), \(x'\), \(\Gamma'\), and the transported good factorization be as in the single-block theta lift.

Definition 6.1 fixes the following notation:

  • \(I_\Gamma\) is the set of active Yu-factor indices; in Case I the final zero factor is omitted, and in Case II it is included.
  • \(\Gamma_L\) is the final nonzero good element in the chosen factorization.
  • \(G^i\), \(\mathbf g^i\), and their target analogues are the twisted Levi sequence attached to the good factorization.
  • \(\mathbf g^{i-1,\perp}\) is the invariant-bilinear-form orthogonal complement of \(\mathbf g^{i-1}\) in \(\mathbf g^i\).
  • \(\alpha:G_x^0\to G'{}_{x'}^0\) is conjugation by \(w\), and \(d\alpha\), \(d\alpha^\perp\) are the skew and symmetric parts of \(X\mapsto wXw^{-1}\): \[ wXw^{-1}=d\alpha(X)+d\alpha^\perp(X). \]
